analyses.name: Marathon Petroleum Corporation
analyses.verdict: The cleanest breakout on the board — an all-time high at 336.42 with RSI only 60.6, still priced at 11x forward earnings.

financials.summary: Marathon Petroleum is the largest independent refiner in the United States, and FY2025 was a year in which the refining cycle turned decisively in its favour. The economics are simple and brutal: MPC earns the spread between crude input costs and refined product prices, so when product markets tighten while crude stays range-bound, essentially all of that widening drops through to operating income. The scan measures earnings growth of +348% and revenue growth of +53.7% year-over-year, which is the signature of exactly that margin expansion rather than of volume growth. The balance sheet supports an aggressive capital-return programme, and management has continued to lean on buybacks, meaningfully shrinking the share count and amplifying per-share earnings. Its midstream stake in MPLX provides a fee-based cash flow stream that partially cushions the inherent volatility of the refining segment. The live income statement, balance sheet and cash-flow detail render in the TradingView financials widget below.

journey_52w.summary: A year of near-continuous re-rating. MPC started from a 52-week low of 156.06 and has more than doubled to 336.42, an all-time high. The move was not a single spike but a stair-step advance: the stock now trades well above its 50-day moving average of 282.35 and its 200-day at 225.19, and critically it reached this high with RSI at only 60.6 — meaning the advance has been orderly enough to keep resetting momentum along the way. The final leg was catalysed by Middle East supply disruption: with Hormuz shipping traffic at a one-week low and product markets tightening, refining margins re-rated sharply. The most recent quarter contributed +34% of three-month momentum.

analyses.name: Valero Energy Corporation
analyses.verdict: The purest refining exposure available, at a new all-time high with RSI under 60 and 11.5x forward earnings.

financials.summary: Valero is the most direct refining play among the US large caps — less midstream ballast than Marathon, less chemicals diversification than Phillips 66, which means its earnings respond more violently to the crack spread in both directions. FY2025 captured that leverage on the way up: the scan measures earnings growth of +453.5%, the largest of any refiner in this universe, on revenue growth of +51.7%. Valero also operates the largest renewable diesel business among the refiners through its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture, which provides a distinct, policy-supported earnings stream alongside conventional refining. The company runs a conservative balance sheet by refining-sector standards and has consistently prioritised returning cash through both dividends and buybacks. analyses.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
analyses.verdict: The highest-quality breakout in the market's new leadership — a $962B bank at an all-time high on 14.5x earnings with zero TradingView sell signals.

financials.summary: JPMorgan is the largest and most diversified bank in the United States, and FY2025 demonstrated why that diversification is the whole point of the franchise. The scan measures earnings growth of +46.9% on revenue growth of +30.4% — an unusual combination for a bank of this size and a reflection of multiple engines firing at once: net interest income benefiting from a rate environment that stayed higher for longer, investment banking and trading revenue recovering with capital-markets activity, and asset and wealth management compounding fee income on higher market levels. The firm's fortress balance sheet, its defining strategic asset, continues to carry capital well in excess of regulatory requirements, which is what allows it to lean into volatility rather than retreat from it. Credit costs remain the line item that matters most for the forward view. Live statement detail renders in the TradingView financials widget below.

analyses.name: Arista Networks, Inc.
analyses.verdict: The one AI-infrastructure name that never broke — a new all-time high while its entire peer group sits 25-60% below theirs.

financials.summary: Arista builds high-performance ethernet switching for datacentres, and FY2025 was the year its architectural bet paid off at scale. The company's proposition is that ethernet, not proprietary interconnect, becomes the backbone of AI training and inference clusters — and the results support it: the scan measures revenue growth of +37.7% alongside earnings growth of +35.7%, meaning Arista is growing fast while expanding margins rather than buying share with price. That combination is rare and it is the core of the investment case. Gross margins remain structurally high for a hardware vendor because the value sits in EOS, the company's single operating-system software stack, which reduces customer operational cost and creates genuine switching friction. Customer concentration among a handful of hyperscalers remains the defining structural feature of the model — both the growth engine and the principal risk. financials.summary: Citizens Financial is a large regional bank built around New England and the Mid-Atlantic, and FY2025 was a year of earnings recovery driven by the same forces lifting the sector: a rate environment that kept asset yields elevated while deposit competition finally eased. As a regional, the two swing factors for the forward view are commercial real-estate credit quality and deposit costs, and both deserve more attention than the headline multiple. financials.summary: Cardinal Health is one of the three companies that distribute the overwhelming majority of pharmaceuticals in the United States, a structurally oligopolistic position that generates enormous revenue on famously thin margins. FY2025, ending in June, was a year of substantial earnings improvement: the scan measures earnings growth of +68.8% against revenue growth of only +5.8%, and that gap is the entire story. Management's push into higher-margin specialty distribution and its medical-products segment turnaround are the levers behind the improvement. The trade-off inherent in the model is that razor-thin margins amplify operational missteps just as effectively as they amplify wins. analyses.verdict: The premier growth franchise in healthcare, consolidating 1.7% below its high with RSI 58.4 — strength without extension.

financials.summary: Eli Lilly has been transformed by the incretin and GLP-1 franchise, and FY2025 shows the scale of it: the scan measures revenue growth of +47.7% with earnings growth of +26.2%. The gap between those two figures is informative — Lilly is deliberately spending enormous sums on manufacturing capacity to meet demand it has struggled to satisfy, so revenue is compounding faster than earnings while that investment cycle runs. That is the right trade-off if demand persists, and it is the principal judgement call in owning the stock. Beyond metabolic health, the company retains a substantial oncology, immunology and neuroscience portfolio, with Alzheimer's therapy representing a genuine additional option. At a $1.08 trillion market capitalisation, Lilly is now among the largest healthcare companies in the world. Live statement detail renders in the TradingView financials widget below.

analyses.name: Snowflake Inc.
analyses.verdict: The most extended stock in the entire 449-name scan — RSI 87.9 after a 120% quarter. Hold it if you own it; do not initiate here.

financials.summary: Snowflake sells a cloud data platform on a consumption model — customers pay for the compute and storage they actually use rather than for seats — which means revenue tracks how much work customers are running. FY2026, ending in January, captured the moment AI workloads became a material driver of that consumption: the scan measures revenue growth of +33.5%. The consumption model is the key to both the bull and bear cases. On the way up it compounds beautifully, because AI training and inference against enterprise data is exactly the kind of workload that expands consumption without requiring new customer acquisition. On the way down it is unforgiving, because customers can throttle spend immediately without cancelling a contract. Profitability on a GAAP basis remains the open question: the scan cannot compute a meaningful earnings growth figure, and the forward multiple of 123.8x reflects a company still valued on revenue and forward margin promise rather than current earnings. analyses.name: NVIDIA Corporation
analyses.verdict: Fully reset at RSI 54.3 and 16.9x forward earnings, but earnings in 15 days will decide the whole AI complex — WATCH into the print.

financials.summary: NVIDIA remains the central company of the AI buildout, supplying the accelerated-computing platform — GPUs plus the CUDA software ecosystem that makes them difficult to displace — on which the majority of AI training and inference runs. FY2026, ending in January, was another year of extraordinary expansion: the scan measures revenue growth of +85.2% and earnings growth of +214.5%, with earnings compounding far faster than revenue because datacentre gross margins are exceptional and operating costs scale slowly against them. At a $5.27 trillion market capitalisation it is the largest company in the scanned universe by a wide margin. The most striking figure in the data is the valuation: a forward P/E of 16.9x, which is lower than many of the mature industrials and banks in today's pick list. That is the market pricing meaningful scepticism about the durability of current earnings — the single most important debate in equities right now. journey_52w.summary: A year that ended in a stall rather than a collapse. NVIDIA ranged between a 52-week low of 164.98 and a high of 235.47, and now sits at 217.50 — 7.6% below the peak with three-month momentum essentially flat at -1.4%. The important observation is relative: while NVIDIA merely consolidated, its supply chain and customer base were dismantled, with ALAB down 35%, MU down 28%, AMAT down 27% and APP down 57% from their respective highs. RSI has fully reset to 54.3 and price holds above both moving averages. The leadership has demonstrably passed to banks, refiners and insurers — but NVIDIA itself has not broken. Earnings on 2026-08-27 is the event that resolves whether this was a pause or a top.
